svg.title: Transport in Irad
svg.desc: Railways, main highways, pipelines, airfields and the three crossings into Kazakhstan set up by the 2008 Northern Border Demarcation Protocol. Routes, places and the Qara-Chik line: Kartalar map data (roads and railways fitted to OpenStreetMap). Base map: Natural Earth (public domain).
